base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T2."XCL_011" = '-' THEN T2."XCL_010" ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT T2."XCL_010")
FROM molecule AS T2
INNER JOIN atom AS T1 ON T1."XCL_002" = T2."XCL_010"
INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2."XCL_010" = T3."XCL_005"
WHERE T3."XCL_006" = '='
  AND T1."XCL_003" = 'h'

SELECT
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN m.XCL_011 = 'non-carcinogenic' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.XCL_010 IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT b.XCL_005
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.XCL_006 = 'double'
)
AND m.XCL_010 IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.XCL_002
    FROM atom a
    WHERE a.XCL_003 = 'H'
)
